name: Nathan Glyde
reason: No published European base: his own sites (ngly.de, DependentOrigination.org, SanghaSeva.org) and his Gaia House teacher bio never say where he lives or is based, only where retreats are held (mostly Devon, London, India, Israel-Palestine), so the base rule says skip. Otherwise a strong candidate: a contact form (ngly.de/contact), many Dharma Seed talks, Gaia House 2027 retreats and monthly online drop-in groups; he co-teaches with Zohar Lavie, so the owner may want to revisit if a base is published.
